content.value_statement: Complex office tasks often require several formats and specialized tools. This skill organizes document, spreadsheet, presentation, conversion, and automation work into clear phases.
actual_capabilities: Plans document creation with LibreOffice Writer, Word, and PDF skills.
Structures spreadsheet work for formulas, imports, charts, and reports.
Coordinates presentation generation for ODP, PowerPoint, and HTML formats.
Guides document, spreadsheet, and PDF format conversion workflows.
Outlines mail merge, file organization, graphics, diagrams, and database reporting phases.
Provides quality checks for formatting, formulas, presentations, conversions, automation, and file organization.
limitations: Requires separately available specialized skills for file creation and conversion.
Does not directly execute office applications or manipulate files.
Cannot guarantee conversion fidelity without reviewing generated files.
Needs user-provided source data, target formats, permissions, and success criteria.

use_cases.title: Create Monthly Business Reports
use_cases.description: Coordinate spreadsheet calculations, charts, narrative documents, and PDF export for a recurring reporting cycle.

use_cases.title: Prepare Course Materials
use_cases.description: Plan handouts, data tables, diagrams, and presentations in formats suitable for classroom distribution.

use_cases.title: Automate Client Deliverables
use_cases.description: Organize template creation, mail merge, format conversion, quality checks, and final file distribution.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a structured office document about [topic]. Use [DOCX or ODT], include [sections], and apply a professional layout.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with one document and a clear target format.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Spreadsheet Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [XLSX or ODS] report from [data source]. Include formulas, summary tables, charts, and validation checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn structured data into an analyzed spreadsheet.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Presentation Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a presentation from [data and narrative]. Produce [PPTX, ODP, or HTML], add charts, and verify every slide.
prompt_templates.scenario: Combine data, narrative, and visuals into a presentation.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Automated Office Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a workflow that imports [source], generates [documents and spreadsheets], converts outputs to [formats], validates quality, and organizes final files.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate several office tools and quality gates.

output_examples.input: Create a monthly sales report from regional totals and export it as XLSX and PDF.
output: Workbook with regional totals, variance formulas, and a sales chart.
Formatted PDF summary with key results and review notes.
Quality checklist covering formulas, layout, and export results.

output_examples.input: Turn a project update and milestone table into a PowerPoint presentation.
output: Presentation outline with title, status, milestones, risks, and next steps.
Slides containing a milestone chart and concise project commentary.
Review checklist for completeness, visual consistency, and export quality.

best_practices: Specify source files, target formats, required sections, and quality criteria before starting.
Review formulas, layouts, charts, and converted files in their intended office applications.
Use specialized skills for each format and keep intermediate files until validation is complete.
anti_patterns: Do not request a complex workflow without providing source data or target formats.
Do not assume converted documents preserve every font, formula, animation, or layout detail.
Do not distribute generated files before checking content, permissions, formulas, and presentation quality.

faq.question: Does this skill create office files directly?
faq.answer: No. It coordinates specialized skills that create, convert, and review office files.

faq.question: Which office formats are covered?
faq.answer: The workflow covers ODT, ODS, ODP, ODG, ODB, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF, HTML slides, and Google Workspace formats.

faq.question: Can it convert files between formats?
faq.answer: Yes. It plans conversions through relevant LibreOffice and PDF skills, followed by quality verification.

faq.question: Can it automate recurring reports?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide templates, data sources, output formats, schedules, and distribution requirements.

faq.question: Does it support charts and diagrams?
faq.answer: Yes. It coordinates spreadsheet charts, LibreOffice Draw graphics, canvas designs, and Mermaid diagrams.

faq.question: What should I provide before starting?
faq.answer: Provide source data, desired outputs, target formats, templates, permissions, quality criteria, and distribution requirements.
